_help: Manual fixes applied by scripts/build-fountains.mjs. This file is never written by the script.
Each override matches a CSV row by venue name + the lat/lng exactly as listed in the CSV
(add "location" inside match to target a single dispenser).
Set "lat"/"lng" to correct the position, "exclude": true to drop the row,
or "access" (public | users_only | hirers_only | restricted) to override access.
Entries with lat/lng null do nothing; they are placeholders for rows the script flagged.
